title.zh: 職場調解與跨部門共識建立 (哈佛雙贏談判與冰山模型)
title.en: Workplace Mediation & Alignment (Harvard Negotiation & Iceberg Model)

slide_title.zh: 商業脈絡與心理安全感建構 (SCQA & Safe Space)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：我們正共同推進 [核心專案]，這對公司本季度的營收與戰略至關重要
衝突 (Complication)：目前在 [流程/資源] 上遭遇僵局，阻礙交付並引發團隊內耗 (Friction)
定調 (Ground Rules)：今日會議為「心理安全空間」，堅持「對事不對人」，將人與問題剝離
en: Situation: We are jointly driving [Core Project], which is critical to our quarterly revenue and strategy.
Complication: An impasse regarding [Process/Resources] is blocking delivery and causing team friction.
Ground Rules: Today is a 'Psychologically Safe Space'. We separate the people from the problem.

speaker_notes.zh: 大家好。我們今天聚在這裡，是因為這個專案對公司至關重要，我們『必須』成功。作為中立的調解人，我首先要確立今天的基調：這是一個心理安全的空間。我們絕不翻舊帳、不指責個人，我們唯一的敵人是『問題本身』，而不是坐在對面的同事。
speaker_notes.en: Welcome. We are here because this project is critical to the company—we must succeed. As a neutral facilitator, let me set the ground rules: this is a psychologically safe space. No pointing fingers, no personal attacks. Our only enemy is the problem itself, not the colleague sitting across from you.

slide_title.zh: 衝突的隱含成本與 BATNA (Cost of Conflict & BATNA)

zh: 量化耗損 (Quantified Drain)：目前的僵局導致每週延遲成本達 [X]，並嚴重消耗組織動能
風險外溢 (Risk Spillover)：若持續卡關，將連帶引發 [客戶流失/合規風險/高層介入]
檢視 BATNA (最佳替代方案)：若今日無法達成協議，雙方的次佳解 (如：專案停擺) 代價皆過於高昂
en: Quantified Drain: The current delay costs [X] weekly and severely depletes organizational energy.
Risk Spillover: Continued bottlenecks will trigger [Client Attrition / Compliance Risks / Exec Escalation].
BATNA Assessment: If we fail to reach an agreement today, both parties' Best Alternative (e.g., project halt) is too costly.

speaker_notes.zh: 在進入細節前，我們必須面對現實。這個僵局不只在燒公司的錢，更在消耗大家的精力。如果今天我們走不出這間會議室，雙方的 BATNA（最佳替代方案）可能就是專案失敗或高層介入強勢裁決，這對雙方都是最差的結果。所以，『合作』是我們唯一的出路。
speaker_notes.en: Before diving into details, let's face reality. This impasse is burning company cash and draining your energy. If we can't align today, our BATNA (Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement)—such as project failure or executive mandates—is disastrous for everyone. Therefore, collaboration is our only viable path.

slide_title.zh: 冰山模型：剝離立場，深掘需求 (Positions vs. Interests)
slide_title.en: The Iceberg Model: Positions vs. Interests

zh: 水面上的立場 (Positions)：A 部門堅持 [某要求]；B 部門堅持 [某底線] (互相衝突)
水面下的需求 (Interests)：深掘背後真正的恐懼或 KPI (如：怕扛全責、預算超支、人力崩潰)
客觀標準 (Objective Criteria)：引入獨立的第三方數據或行業標準，避免陷入主觀的情緒角力
en: Surface Positions: Dept A demands [Condition]; Dept B insists on [Baseline] (Direct conflict).
Submerged Interests: Digging into the real fears/KPIs beneath (e.g., Fear of liability, budget caps, burnout).
Objective Criteria: Introducing independent data or industry standards to avoid subjective emotional tug-of-wars.

speaker_notes.zh: 衝突往往來自表面的『立場』。我們用冰山模型來看，水面上的堅持是會打架的；但如果我們深掘水面下的『需求』（例如：某部門其實是怕合規風險，另一部門是怕人力崩潰），我們就會發現，雙方的深層需求其實並不衝突。我們接下來用客觀數據來一一檢視。
speaker_notes.en: Conflict usually stems from surface 'Positions'. Using the Iceberg Model, visible demands clash; but if we dive into the submerged 'Interests' (e.g., one dept fears compliance risks, the other fears burnout), we often find these underlying needs are not mutually exclusive. Let's use objective data to examine this.

slide_title.zh: 尋找 ZOPA 與雙贏價值交換 (ZOPA & Value Exchange)
slide_title.en: Finding the ZOPA & Win-Win Value Exchange

zh: 協議可能空間 (ZOPA)：界定雙方底線的交集處，鎖定 [某資源互換/流程折衷] 為突破口
價值交換 (Trade-offs)：提議 [A 部門] 讓步 [某條件]，換取 [B 部門] 承諾提供 [某支援]
共創選項 (Inventing Options)：跳脫零和遊戲 (Zero-sum)，共同設計 [新流程/自動化機制] 做大蛋糕
en: Zone of Possible Agreement (ZOPA): Identifying the overlap in bottom lines; targeting [Resource swap] as the breakthrough.
Value Exchange (Trade-offs): Proposing [Dept A] concedes [Condition] for [Dept B]'s pledge of [Support].
Inventing Options: Escaping the zero-sum game by co-designing [New Process/Automation] to expand the pie.

speaker_notes.zh: 找到了彼此的深層需求後，我們就能劃出 ZOPA（協議可能空間）。這不是零和遊戲，我們不是來切一塊固定的蛋糕，而是要透過資源互換把蛋糕做大。只要 A 部門在這個環節多擔待一點，B 部門就能在後端提供自動化支援，這就是雙贏。
speaker_notes.en: Having identified our true interests, we can map out the ZOPA (Zone of Possible Agreement). This isn't a zero-sum game where we divide a fixed pie; we are here to expand the pie through trade-offs. If Dept A absorbs a bit more here, Dept B can provide automated support downstream. That is a win-win.

slide_title.zh: 行動承諾與 RACI 落地計畫 (Action Plan & RACI)

zh: 當責矩陣 (RACI)：明確界定新流程中的 負責人(R)、當責者(A)、諮詢者(C) 與 知會者(I)
SMART 行動清單：鎖定未來 14 天的具體產出與里程碑，雙方主管簽字背書
期望管理與復盤 (Follow-up)：規劃於 [日期] 進行進度查核，若遇突發變數則啟動快速升級機制
en: RACI Matrix: Clearly defining Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed roles for the new workflow.
SMART Action Plan: Locking in specific deliverables and milestones for the next 14 days, endorsed by both heads.
Follow-up & Escalation: Scheduling a check-in on [Date] and establishing a rapid escalation protocol for unforeseen variables.

speaker_notes.zh: 調解的成功與否，取決於走出會議室後的執行力。我們已經把共識轉化為嚴格的 RACI 當責矩陣與 SMART 行動清單，確保不再有灰色地帶。稍後請雙方主管確認背書，我們下週同一時間進行進度查核，確保新機制完美落地。
speaker_notes.en: The success of any mediation relies entirely on execution once we leave this room. We've translated our consensus into a strict RACI matrix and SMART action plan to eliminate any gray areas. I'll ask both department heads to endorse this today. We will reconvene next week to ensure the new mechanism is fully operational.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『職場調解與跨部門共識建立』簡報。受眾為面臨嚴重協作瓶頸、甚至情緒對立的跨部門團隊與主管。內容必須結合高階 HR 視角與哈佛談判專案 (Harvard Negotiation Project) 邏輯：1. 開場建立『心理安全感』，強調對事不對人，2. 運用 BATNA 概念凸顯不合作的巨大隱含成本，3. 引入『冰山模型 (Iceberg Model)』剝離表面的立場 (Positions) 並深掘真實需求 (Interests)，4. 在 ZOPA (協議可能空間) 內促成雙贏的價值交換，打破零和遊戲，5. 結尾必須產出嚴謹的 RACI 當責矩陣與 SMART 行動清單。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需具備資深調解員的同理心、絕對的中立性以及不容妥協的商業推進魄力。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Workplace Mediation & Cross-Functional Alignment' presentation in English. Audience: Cross-functional teams/managers facing severe bottlenecks or emotional friction. Integrate Senior HR perspectives with Harvard Negotiation Project principles: 1. Establish Psychological Safety upfront (separate people from the problem). 2. Use BATNA to highlight the disastrous cost of non-agreement. 3. Apply the 'Iceberg Model' to peel back surface Positions and uncover true Interests. 4. Navigate the ZOPA (Zone of Possible Agreement) to facilitate win-win value exchange, escaping zero-sum dynamics. 5. Conclude with a strict RACI matrix and SMART action plan. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must reflect a veteran mediator: profoundly empathetic, strictly neutral, yet fiercely driven by commercial resolution.
